Name: Zechariah, Prince of Reuben
Summary: Named among the chief brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:7: Named among the chief brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zechariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
